unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U12: Distinguish partner liability,holding out and transfer of economic interests

payload.title: External exposure is not the profit-sharing ratio
payload.core_explanation_md:
Partners have the described joint and several liability for firm acts done while they are partners. Wrongful acts and misapplication require the relevant ordinary-course, authority or custody conditions; a claim is not established merely by labelling someone a partner. A creditor claim and the partners internal sharing or contribution are distinct questions.

Holding out concerns a representation of partnership, or knowingly allowing it, and the credit given on faith of that representation. Mere use of a deceased partner name does not automatically impose the same exposure on the estate. A transferee of a partner economic interest generally receives the described profit entitlement during continuation, without thereby acquiring management or account-inspection rights. Dissolution introduces a different assets/accounts entitlement.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a transferee of profit entitlement automatically become a manager?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Economic transfer and admission as a partner differ.

payload.stem_md: A person knowingly allows a firm to present them as a partner, and a supplier gives credit relying on that representation. Which doctrine should be considered?

options.text_md: Holding out, subject to its representation and reliance conditions
options.explanation_md: The stipulated facts engage that analysis.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The stipulated facts engage that analysis.

payload.stem_md: A partner transfers a profit interest to an outsider who demands daily management access solely because of that transfer. What is the relevant distinction?

options.text_md: Every transferee automatically replaces all partners
options.explanation_md: Transfer alone does not have that effect.

options.text_md: Economic entitlement differs from management and inspection rights during continuation
options.explanation_md: Admission and transfer must not be conflated.

options.text_md: Economic interests can never be transferred
options.explanation_md: The source recognises a qualified transfer.

options.text_md: The outsider must own all firm property
options.explanation_md: A profit interest is not that ownership.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Admission and transfer must not be conflated.
